name: Hermitage Bay
insider_take: This adults-only sanctuary sits on one of Antigua's most pristine and secluded beaches, where luxury cottages blend seamlessly into the hillside rainforest.
whats_special: Hermitage Bay features just 30 individual hillside suites, each with private plunge pools and unobstructed Caribbean views. The property spans 17 acres of unspoiled coastline with powder-soft sand and crystal-clear waters. As part of The Signature Collection, it maintains an intimate boutique feel while delivering world-class amenities.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at the beachfront restaurant - the resort's location on Antigua's west coast offers some of the island's most spectacular sunset views over the Caribbean Sea.
dont_miss: The resort's organic garden supplies fresh herbs and vegetables to the restaurant, and the nearby Fig Tree Drive offers one of the Caribbean's most scenic rainforest drives. The property also provides complimentary snorkeling gear to explore the vibrant coral reefs just steps from your suite.
pros: Stunning secluded beachfront location with pristine white sand
Luxurious hillside suites with private pools and ocean views
Exceptional personalized service and attention to detail
Award-winning spa and wellness facilities in tropical setting
cons: Remote location requires planning for off-site activities
